name: MHRA authorises orforglipron (Foundayo)
summary: The MHRA authorised orforglipron (Foundayo), a GLP-1 tablet, for weight management and type 2 diabetes, saying the UK is the first country in Europe to do so.
keyPoints: The MHRA authorised orforglipron (Foundayo) on 10 August 2026.
The MHRA says the UK is the first country in Europe to authorise this GLP-1 tablet for weight management and type 2 diabetes.
For weight management it is licensed for adults.
For type 2 diabetes it is licensed to improve blood sugar control in people whose diabetes is not controlled well enough.

body.heading: What was announced
body.body: The MHRA says it authorised orforglipron, sold as Foundayo, on 10 August 2026. It describes orforglipron as a GLP-1 tablet, and says the UK is the first country in Europe to authorise it for weight management and type 2 diabetes.

body.heading: What the authorisation covers
body.body: For weight management, the licence covers adults. For type 2 diabetes, it is licensed to improve glycaemic (blood sugar) control in people whose diabetes is insufficiently controlled.

source.title: UK first in Europe to authorise orforglipron for weight management and type 2 diabetes
